name: prize-a
prompt: Comic book painting in heavy black brush ink with one gold spot colour: a large black graphics-processor chip standing upright and facing the viewer head-on, like a championship belt on display, at the centre of an empty boxing ring at night. The chip's face is matte black with a gold rim and gold leads along its bottom edge, and across its face four identical flat empty black rectangular windows in a single row, evenly spaced, perfectly frontal and plain. One overhead spotlight makes a pool of light on the canvas, ring ropes and corner posts fade into deep black darkness, crowd invisible. Crisp ink contours, cross-hatching in the shadows, no colour except black, cream and gold. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no green.

name: prize-b
prompt: Comic book painting in heavy black brush ink with one gold spot colour: an empty boxing ring at night seen from ringside, a single overhead spotlight, and at its centre on a short black pedestal a big square black microchip lying flat and tilted toward the viewer, gold leads on all sides glowing in the light, its top a plain flat empty matte black surface. Ropes and corner posts fade into deep darkness. Crisp ink contours, cross-hatching only in the shadows, only black, cream and gold. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signs, no green, no people.

name: chip-black-a
prompt: Comic book painting in heavy black brush ink, a single microchip seen exactly from straight above, square matte black solder-mask package, a neat row of polished silver leads on all four sides, in the centre a large square recessed window that is perfectly flat, plain and empty dark charcoal, nothing printed on it. One hard white key light from the top left, crisp ink contour lines, fine cross-hatching only in the shadow on the lower right edge. Pure black background, the chip centred with a generous black margin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no green, no circuit board.
